scope: actual Linux Electron bundle spawning its embedded native backend and actual app page

checks.name: bundle spawned embedded backend without attached URL
actual app page has one compact native window
actual app compact root and body backgrounds are transparent
create self-service character in real UI
real backend validates PNG and returns isolated preview
activate uploaded PNG in actual character stage
collapse preserves uploaded character in same page
actual app can enable timed click-through
restore recovers actual app pointer state
real hide sets explicit host media guard
actual app has no JavaScript page exceptions
desktop quit stops owned backend and focus helper

limitations: Only the executing OS/CI display; physical Windows 10/11, multi-DPI/multi-monitor/fullscreen not covered
Synthetic PNG tests import mechanics, not anime artwork quality
No model/voice quality evaluation in this check
